description: This file contains service functions for interacting with a backend API, including fetching events, creating events, and retrieving current weather and forecast data. It exports functions that handle HTTP requests and normalization of responses.

methods.name: http(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using fetch, handles response parsing and error handling.

methods.name: getEvents({ page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of events with pagination, normalizing different backend payload shapes to an array.

methods.name: createEvent(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new event by sending payload to backend API.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches current weather data based on query parameters or coordinates.

methods.name: getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data based on query parameters or coordinates.

ctags.name: getCurrentWeather
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: getForecast
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/
